feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.private: Your answers are private. Nobody sees what you said about them.
feedback.whoWasThereHint: Everyone is ticked. Untick anyone who didn’t come.
feedback.meetAgainEffect: If you both say yes, you can be matched together again after 4 weeks instead of 6 months. If either of you says no, you won't be matched together again. Nobody is told what you answered.

member.title: Member
member.blockBody: You will never be matched again, and photos are hidden both ways.
member.blockExplainer: Blocking is immediate. In an active pod, the blocked member is removed; the others only see that the pod changed.
member.blockBodyReplan: You will never be matched again, photos are hidden both ways, and the pod plans a new meetup within 48 hours.
member.replanExplainer: They already know where and when you're meeting. Re-planning picks a new time and place within 48 hours.

report.title: Report
report.intro: Reports are confidential. We never tell anyone who reported them.
report.messageCopy: We keep a copy of this message with your report for 12 months, also after the chat is deleted.
report.textWarning: Please don't include sensitive details about anyone.
